items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson left Sunday's game with a left ankle injury, exited the stadium in a walking boot, and is scheduled for an MRI today. Initial reports indicate day-to-day.
items.why: Left in boot after mid-game exit; Rapoport and GMFB align on day-to-day with tests Monday.
items.implication: Monitor MRI results closely for Week 5 availability vs ATL; Huntley filled in.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase suffered a concussion in the first half vs Jaguars and was ruled out; enters protocol. Tee Higgins also exited with adductor injury.
items.why: Facemask/hit led to concussion evaluation and ruling out; Higgins adductor in fourth quarter.
items.implication: Chase likely misses or is limited for Week 5 at MIA (protocol average ~9-15 days); Bengals WR corps depleted.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining CIN receivers if both limited.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries watching list: Lamar (ankle), Chase (concussion)/Higgins (adductor), Saquon (hamstring)/Bigsby (undisclosed), Rice (hamstring)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot), DJ Moore (shoulder), Monangai (thumb), Pat Bryant (ankle), others. Pregame expected: Nacua/Flowers/McConkey/Spears; GTD Evans; not expected McLaurin/etc; Bagent starting.
items.why: Comprehensive pre/post lists parsing all OUT/Q/EXPECTED/GTD/IN; Nacua etc confirmed played as expected.
items.implication: Central hub for status changes and beneficiaries across slate; high volume of key fantasy injuries Week 4.
items.opportunity: Parse per-player for handcuffs/upgrades (e.g. backups behind outs).

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley downgraded to out with hamstring injury early in Week 4 vs Rams after just two carries; left limping.
items.why: Pulled up on run in first quarter; Schefter confirmed downgrade to out. Already dealing with prior stinger issues.
items.implication: Likely misses at least Week 5 in London vs JAC; Eagles offense already depleted (Smith/Goedert out).
items.opportunity: Committee of Tank Bigsby (early-down) and Will Shipley (pass downs); Bigsby also exited late with own issue.

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson confirms Tyson Bagent expected to start Sunday at Green Bay; Caleb Williams continues working back. Two-QB system out.
items.why: Johnson on radio: 'Tyson will be the guy.' Rapoport confirms.
items.implication: Bagent gets Week 5 start vs GB; impacts CHI skill players' efficiency/ceilings until Williams returns.
items.opportunity: Full starter snaps for Bagent; monitor Williams practice progress.

items.text: Broncos WR Pat Bryant sprained ankle Sunday, expected to miss 'a few weeks' per Schefter. Rapoport later: MRI good news, avoided worst-case, short-term absence expected (alongside Surtain).
items.why: Carted off; Schefter 'few weeks', Rapoport short-term after MRI. ETR watching list.
items.implication: Miss 1-3 weeks likely; DEN WR depth tested (Sutton primary).
items.opportunity: Targets shift to Courtland Sutton and others short-term.
items.conflict: Schefter 'few weeks' vs Rapoport 'short-term' good news — monitor exact timeline.

items.text: Bills OC Joe Brady on Dalton Kincaid's two targets: 'I have to be better. There is no reason Dalton Kincaid should have two targets.' Target shares without DJ Moore showed Kincaid at 13%.
items.why: Coach self-critique after low involvement; Moore shoulder aggravation (not long-term) opened shares to Coleman/Shakir/Cook/Palmer/Kincaid.
items.implication: Expect increased routes/targets for Kincaid going forward, especially if Moore limited.
items.opportunity: TE target share expansion in Bills offense; third-down/two-minute upside.

items.text: Puka Nacua played 76-of-84 snaps in return from hip/groin, ran 49 routes on 64 dropbacks, 12 targets plus goal-line carry. Hysteria overstated; Rams had no workload limit per Schefter.
items.why: Full snap/route/target share confirmed post-game; ETR projected expected to play with small dock only.
items.implication: Immediate full WR1 role restored; no lingering restriction expected ROS if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target/red-zone share locked in with Stafford.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management (only 11 second-half plays in close game); says ankle maintenance + workload management to stay fresh, not new injury. Coaches managing longest year of his life.
items.why: Post-game quotes via beat: not injured but body management limiting spectacular plays and late-game usage.
items.implication: Ceiling capped by committee/management; frustrating for fantasy despite talent. Monitor for expanded role if improves.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore aggravated shoulder injury Sunday; not considered a long-term issue as of now.
items.why: Exited early; Schefter source confirms not long-term currently. ETR/Berry noted early exit.
items.implication: Likely available Week 5 or soon; temporary target share to Coleman/Shakir/Kincaid while out.
items.opportunity: Short-term boost to Keon Coleman et al. if limited.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful with hamstring; will use upcoming bye to recover. Tyquan Thornton out indefinitely (dislocated ankle).
items.why: Hamstring tweak in game; Rapoport notes bye recovery window. Thornton season-threatening.
items.implication: Rice should be ready post-bye Week 6; opens short-term WR opportunity and accelerates Tyreek Hill free-agent interest/reunion talks.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and others elevated; Tyreek Hill negotiations starting with Chiefs among teams.

items.text: Matthew Berry identifies Chuba Hubbard as 'this year's Javonte Williams' — the boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role uncertainty who is starting and crushing.
items.why: Role solidified into every-week starter producing despite preseason doubts.
items.implication: Strong ROS hold/start; mid-round value smash.
items.opportunity: Lead back carries/snaps in CAR offense.

items.text: Not one but two Bhayshul Tuten touchdowns called back due to penalty in Week 4.
items.why: Live observation of two TDs nullified; shows goal-line/red-zone involvement for JAC rookie.
items.implication: Positive underlying opportunity despite zero official TDs; handcuff/breakout watch if role grows.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/goal-line carries present even if production wiped.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot aggravation) listed expected to play / active for Week 4; Schefter confirmed active. ETR had bigger dock but projected in; post-game watching list notes aggravation.
items.why: ETR weekend summary expected; Schefter active confirmation. Foot/ribs history but played.
items.implication: Played through; monitor for Week 5 lingering effects but no new major setback reported.
items.opportunity: Continued high route/target share if healthy.
